cases.input: I join employee records with attitude surveys, use statistical programming to model workforce outcomes, and analyze open-ended comments with machine learning. I also test whether staff selection assessments measure the intended psychological traits and summarize what the findings mean for HR decisions.
cases.rationale: Data science covers programming, ML, structured/unstructured data and reporting; IO psychology covers employee psychological testing and selection. No system integration or search marketing is described.

cases.input: My research examines motivation and performance at work. I develop employee selection tests, study the validity of psychological assessments, and evaluate training programs so organizations can improve how they select and develop staff.
cases.rationale: IO psychology explicitly covers employee testing, selection, training and development. Optional alternatives require source support.
